answer: Stop sybils with a crystal inlet anchor: an agent stakes a bond for one inlet. Each cycle it drops one crystal anchor in the inlet; it flashes once, and verifiers match the flash to the inlet chart, voiding an inlet whose flash is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 inlets at 17x: one crystal anchors one inlet for one flash, and it cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents drop once, keep rights.
